verdict.rationale: Pilot documents its own AI that gives instant answers about past transactions and current cash flow and can run scenarios, and it markets knowing whether you can afford new hires. That covers the core of asking 'can we afford X?' against live books. However, nothing shows an external agent pulling ledger data through an API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented public API for ledger data, external or agent access to that data, independent or hands-on corroboration that the AI's affordability answers are grounded in live ledger data.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios to plan ahead
Know if you can afford new hires well before you make the offers.
stay up to date with real time account data directly in the portal
